### Reproduced behavior and current intent

This is a **correctness/retained-history improvement for intentionally permissive caller-supplied JSON**, not a claim that the live `readPmItems` completeness fix regressed.

With published `pm-changelog@2026.10.4` (registry gitHead `5de5ffe853d8d0bada163868b492c11da95321cf`), Node 26.9.0, in an isolated fixture with public core 2026.10.5:

```js
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
const input = {
  items: [{
    id: 'pm-review-feature', title: 'Synthetic preserved feature',
    type: 'Feature', status: 'closed', priority: 2, tags: [],
    created_at: '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z',
    updated_at: '2026-10-05T00:00:00Z',
    closed_at: '2026-10-05T00:00:00Z', body: 'Synthetic fixture'
  }],
  count: 1, total: 2, has_more: true,
  next_cursor: 'synthetic-next-page', truncated: true,
  completeness: {
    status: 'complete', unreadable_item_count: 0,
    unreadable_directory_count: 0
  },
  read_output: {
    contract_version: 1, command: 'list',
    requested_dimensions: ['include', 'amount', 'cost'],
    within_budget: true, strings_compacted: false,
    rows_compacted: true, result_omitted: false
  }
};
const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, [
  'node_modules/pm-changelog/dist/cli.js',
  '--stdin', '--stdout', '--version', '2026.10.5', '--date', '2026-10-05'
], { input: JSON.stringify(input), encoding: 'utf8' });
console.log(result.status, result.stderr, result.stdout);
```

Actual: exit **0**, empty stderr, ordinary changelog containing the one supplied feature, with no pagination/truncation disclosure. The two-item complete baseline also succeeds. In review this was run by an external fixture driver rather than an internal Node subprocess, with synthetic data and no Git/service/model calls.

### Source

Current main `3e31f7b89f6595c654de616d51772d1ff391f872` routes both [stdin and input files](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/blob/3e31f7b89f6595c654de616d51772d1ff391f872/src/cli.ts#L722) through [parsePmItemsJson](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/blob/3e31f7b89f6595c654de616d51772d1ff391f872/src/generator.ts#L796), which extracts `items` and intentionally ignores the envelope. `parseListAllItemsJson` already refuses incomplete live answers.

Accepting bare arrays and caller-selected subsets can remain useful. The narrower concern is that an actual PM envelope explicitly says more rows or compacted content exist, and that knowledge disappears from the generated artifact/receipt. The documented pipe workflow makes this relevant to release automation when an upstream read becomes bounded.

### Acceptance

- Recognize explicit PM completeness/pagination/compaction signals on `--stdin` and `--input`.
- Refuse explicitly incomplete PM envelopes by default, or require an explicit partial-generation choice and disclose counts, omissions, and scope in the generation receipt.
- Preserve a documented path for intentional bare-array/subset generation; do not mistake ordinary status/date filtering for incomplete retrieval.
- Share the envelope policy through the public SDK and test file/stdin, complete, paginated, unreadable, and compacted inputs.
- Do not replace a full changelog with a partial one while returning an undisclosed success.

Dedup: all-state public issues/PRs (222 entries), source tracker, and current source checked October 5; no open matching fix. Completed `pmc-wv37` / PR143 fixes live-reader receipt validation; #147 / `pmc-6j4o` fixes unbounded live argv. This concerns caller-supplied envelopes and preserves their intentionally different bare-array contract.

### GitHub comments (1)

> **@unbraind** (2026-10-13T09:26:26Z)
>
> Shipped-artifact verification on 13 October: this repair is now independently reproduced in official `pm-changelog@2026.10.12` (registry gitHead `e1cb8852ae27f29ca643f1c75051feb29704d4cd`, published 12 October at 10:55:11.101 UTC). The downloaded tarball matches its registry SHA-512 and all 42 installed package files match the tarball. Environment: Linux x86_64, Node 24.19.0, official `@unbrained/pm-cli@2026.10.13`.
> 
> Using synthetic two-item fixtures, three repeats of each stdin/file route now give:
> - Explicit partial envelope (`count:1,total:2,has_more:true,truncated:true,read_output.rows_compacted:true`): exit 1, zero stdout, actionable incompleteness diagnostics
> - Complete two-item envelope: exit 0, both item identities retained
> - Intentional bare two-item array: exit 0, both identities retained
> 
> That is 18 CLI checks plus nine public `parsePmItemsJson` checks. Six additional partial-input checks with an existing `--output` file leave the original complete-history bytes unchanged. The bounded reproduction uses `pm-changelog --stdin --version 2026.10.13 --date 2026-10-13 --format json`, or replaces `--stdin` with `--input fixture.json`; the output-preservation control adds `--output retained.md`.
> 
> Expected and observed: explicitly incomplete envelopes refuse before replacing a complete changelog, while documented caller-owned array subsets remain usable. This verifies the shipped part of [pmc-n4qu](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/blob/e1cb8852ae27f29ca643f1c75051feb29704d4cd/.agents/pm/issues/pmc-n4qu.toon), without reopening or duplicating the completed owner.
> 
> Limits: bounded installed CLI/API fixtures, not a full source suite, every malformed receipt, live workspace acquisition, Bun/Windows, or autonomous agent-discovery test. No implementation or publication changes were made.
Expose or refuse explicit partial-read receipts on stdin and input JSON
